sources.title: Luzerne County Election Summary Report, Closed Primary April 23, 2024 (report dated 4/9/2025), listed as 'General Primary Election Results 2024' in the county's results archive
Luzerne County 2026 Primary Election results (Clarity, detail XML timestamp 5/26/2026): contains Democratic county committee contests and no Republican county committee contests

notes: Luzerne County Republicans elect county committee in presidential-year primaries: the 2026 primary results contain Democratic committeeman and committeewoman contests but no Republican county committee contests, so the latest evidence is the April 23, 2024 primary, more than two years old. Each of 186 precincts has one 'Member of the Republican County Committee' contest with Vote For 2 (counties.geojson lists 183 precincts). Status rules: filed candidate ranked inside the top two among filed candidates and named write-ins, with votes = filled (unknown on a cutoff tie or if unresolved write-ins exceeded that candidate); seats won by named write-ins are unknown because acceptance was not verified; open seats are unknown when write-in votes were cast and empty when none were. Vacancies filled or opened since 2024 are not reflected. The county results document does not say 'official' in its text; it was posted in the county's archive after certification.
